# Accessibility Source Product

## Product Story
This product helps accessibility teams carry out the explicitly supplied first path.

## Source Evidence
Repository: unovue/reka-ui
An open-source UI component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps for Vue. Previously Radix Vue

## First Complete Path
A case manager creates an eligibility record, routes a service decision, and verifies a resolution notice.

## Proof Boundary
The source evidence, decision, and outcome remain traceable.

cases.name: research source case 165
cases.prompt: Build a research product. User intent: A field operator submits an exception packet, records an approval outcome, and verifies a public status. Source repository: dzhng/deep-research. Source evidence: An AI-powered research assistant that performs iterative, deep research on any topic by combining search engines, web scraping, and large language models.
